run_oneshot_quantization: run the oneshot quantization API to apply W4AFP8 quantization to a Hugging Face causal language model
create_gptq_modifier: create a GPTQModifier recipe targeting Linear layers with W4AFP8 quantization scheme and ignoring lm_head
preprocess_dataset: preprocess a HuggingFace dataset by applying chat templates from a tokenizer to conversation messages
tokenize_dataset: tokenize dataset samples with a tokenizer using truncation, max length, and no padding
save_quantized_model: save a quantized model and tokenizer to disk in pack-quantized format for vLLM compatibility
